**User:**

<user_message>
Redesign the visual design of the whole /frontend app. This is a design pass only: do NOT change behaviour, routes, API calls or anything under /backend.

Rules for tests: all existing tests must keep passing. Where a test asserts on text or markup that the redesign legitimately changes, update only that assertion, and list every such change in your final summary. Never delete or weaken a test.

Design direction: a premium dark "car showroom" feel.
- Palette: near-black navy background (around #0B1020), raised surfaces slightly lighter with a 1px subtle border and soft shadow, light text (high contrast, WCAG AA), a single warm accent (amber/orange gradient) for primary actions and highlights, green for in-stock, amber for low stock, red for out of stock/destructive. Define these as Tailwind theme extensions (colors, shadows, radii) in tailwind.config.js rather than scattering hex values.
- Typography: install @fontsource-variable/inter for body text and @fontsource/sora (weights 600 and 700) for headings and prices; import them in main.tsx. Clear hierarchy, tabular numbers for prices.
- Icons: install lucide-react and use it for the logo mark, search, filters, stock, edit, restock, delete, logout and similar. Use no other new dependencies.

Components and pages:
1. Navbar: sticky, translucent blur, logo mark plus wordmark, role badge (Admin / User) next to the email, logout button, a working mobile menu.
2. Auth pages (login and register): split layout. On large screens a brand panel on the left (headline, short value proposition, a decorative gradient and inline-SVG car silhouette) and the form on the right; on mobile only the form. Inputs with leading icons, show/hide password toggle, clear focus rings, a polished primary button with its loading spinner.
3. Dashboard: a hero banner with a headline, a one-line subtitle and a stats strip (total vehicles, in stock, categories) computed from the loaded data. Below it a sticky filter bar with category chips (All plus each category), the text and price inputs, and a Clear button.
4. Vehicle card: replace the plain gradient header with an inline-SVG illustration per category (sedan, SUV, hatchback, truck, coupe, electric; a generic fallback) on a category-tinted gradient, with the make initials subtly in the background. Big price in the heading font, model as the title, make as an eyebrow label, a stock indicator with a small progress bar and colored label, a full-width gradient Purchase button (clear disabled state for out of stock). Admin buttons appear as a compact icon row only for admins. Hover: gentle lift and glow.
5. Modals: matching dark surfaces, backdrop blur, smooth fade and scale entrance.
6. Feedback: replace inline confirmations with a toast system (bottom-right on desktop, top on mobile, auto-dismiss, aria-live polite, dismissible). Keep error messages inside the relevant component too.
7. States: shimmer skeleton cards, an illustrated empty state, a friendly error state with Retry.
8. Motion: subtle and fast (150 to 250 ms), staggered card fade-in on load, and everything respects prefers-reduced-motion.
9. Responsive from 360px wide up, with no horizontal scrolling. Keyboard focus visible everywhere. Colour is never the only carrier of meaning (stock states also have text).
10. Set the page title and favicon (an inline SVG favicon) and a sensible meta description in index.html.

Verify: run npm test, npm run build and npm run lint inside /frontend and show me the results. Do not leave a dev server running. Do not run git commit.
</user_message>

  9 | 
 10 | /** Selectors for elements that can receive keyboard focus. */
 11 | const FOCUSABLE =
 12 |   'a[href], button:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
 13 | 
 14 | /**
 15 |  * Accessible modal shell rendered in a portal.
 16 |  * Sets aria-modal, closes on Escape and backdrop click, traps focus while
 17 |  * open and restores focus to the previously focused element on close.
 18 |  */
 19 | export default function Modal({ title, onClose, children }: ModalProps) {
 20 |   const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 21 |   const previouslyFocusedRef = useRef<Element | null>(null);
 22 | 
 23 |   useEffect(() => {
 24 |     previouslyFocusedRef.current = document.activeElement;
 25 | 
 26 |     // Move focus into the dialog on open.
 27 |     const dialog = dialogRef.current;
 28 |     dialog?.focus();
 29 | 
 30 |     return () => {
 31 |       // Restore focus to the trigger on close.
 32 |       if (previouslyFocusedRef.current instanceof HTMLElement) {
 33 |         previouslyFocusedRef.current.focus();
 34 |       }
 35 |     };
 36 |   }, []);
 37 | 
 38 |   useEffect(() => {
 39 |     function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 40 |       if (event.key === 'Escape') {
 41 |         event.preventDefault();
 42 |         onClose();
 43 |         return;
 44 |       }
 45 | 
 46 |       if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
 47 | 
 48 |       const dialog = dialogRef.current;
 49 |       if (!dialog) return;
 50 | 
 51 |       const focusable = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE));
 52 | 
 53 |       if (focusable.length === 0) {
 54 |         event.preventDefault();
 55 |         dialog.focus();
 56 |         return;
 57 |       }
 58 | 
 59 |       const first = focusable[0];
 60 |       const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
 61 | 
 62 |       if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
 63 |         event.preventDefault();
 64 |         last.focus();
 65 |       } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
 66 |         event.preventDefault();
 67 |         first.focus();
 68 |       }
 69 |     }
 70 | 
 71 |     document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
 72 |     return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
 73 |   }, [onClose]);
 74 | 
 75 |   return createPortal(
 76 |     <div
 77 |       className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
 78 |       data-testid="modal-backdrop"
 79 |       onClick={onClose}
 80 |     >
 81 |       <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/50" aria-hidden="true" />
 82 |       <div
 83 |         ref={dialogRef}
 84 |         role="dialog"
 85 |         aria-modal="true"
 86 |         aria-labelledby="modal-title"
 87 |         tabIndex={-1}
 88 |         onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
 89 |         className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-lg focus:outline-none"
 90 |       >
 91 |         <h2 id="modal-title" className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
 92 |           {title}
 93 |         </h2>
 94 |         {children}
 95 |       </div>
 96 |     </div>,
 97 |     document.body,
 98 |   );
 99 | }

229 | /** Computes the subset of fields that differ from the initial vehicle. */
230 | function buildChanges(
231 |   values: { make: string; model: string; category: string; price: string; quantity: string },
232 |   initial: Vehicle,
233 | ): UpdateVehicleInput {
234 |   const changes: UpdateVehicleInput = {};
235 | 
236 |   const make = values.make.trim();
237 |   const model = values.model.trim();
238 |   const category = values.category.trim();
239 |   const price = Number(values.price);
240 |   const quantity = parseQuantity(values.quantity);
241 | 
242 |   if (make !== initial.make) changes.make = make;
243 |   if (model !== initial.model) changes.model = model;
244 |   if (category !== initial.category) changes.category = category;
245 |   if (price !== initial.price) changes.price = price;
246 |   if (quantity !== initial.quantity) changes.quantity = quantity;
247 | 
248 |   return changes;
249 | }

 10 | import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
 11 | import {

 16 | } from '../api/client';
 17 | import type { User } from '../types';
 18 | 
 19 | const USER_KEY = 'user';
 20 | 
 21 | /** Shape exposed to consumers via useAuth(). */
 22 | interface AuthContextValue {
 23 |   user: User | null;
 24 |   token: string | null;
 25 |   isAdmin: boolean;
 26 |   login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
 27 |   register: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
 28 |   logout: () => void;
 29 | }
 30 | 
 31 | const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
 32 | 
 33 | /** Safely reads persisted JSON from localStorage, returning null on any failure. */
 34 | function readPersistedUser(): User | null {
 35 |   try {
 36 |     const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
 37 |     return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as User) : null;
 38 |   } catch {
 39 |     return null;
 40 |   }
 41 | }
 42 | 
 43 | /** Safely reads the persisted token from localStorage, returning null on any failure. */
 44 | function readPersistedToken(): string | null {
 45 |   try {
 46 |     return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
 47 |   } catch {
 48 |     return null;
 49 |   }
 50 | }
 51 | 
 52 | /**
 53 |  * Provides authentication state to the app.
 54 |  * Persists token and user in localStorage, wrapped in try/catch for safety.
 55 |  */
 56 | export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
 57 |   const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(() => readPersistedToken());
 58 |   const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(() => readPersistedUser());
 59 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
 60 | 
 61 |   const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
 62 |     const result = await apiLogin(email, password);
 63 |     try {
 64 |       localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, result.token);
 65 |       localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(result.user));
 66 |     } catch {
 67 |       // Persistence is best-effort; the in-memory session still works.
 68 |     }
 69 |     setToken(result.token);
 70 |     setUser(result.user);
 71 |   }, []);
 72 | 
 73 |   const register = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
 74 |     // Registration does not create a session; the caller redirects to /login.
 75 |     await apiRegister(email, password);
 76 |   }, []);
 77 | 
 78 |   const logout = useCallback(() => {
 79 |     try {
 80 |       localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
 81 |       localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
 82 |     } catch {
 83 |       // Ignore storage failures during logout.
 84 |     }
 85 |     setToken(null);
 86 |     setUser(null);
 87 |   }, []);
 88 | 
 89 |   // Register a global 401 handler so expired sessions clear state and redirect.
 90 |   useEffect(() => {
 91 |     setUnauthorizedHandler(() => {
 92 |       logout();
 93 |       navigate('/login');
 94 |     });
 95 |     return () => setUnauthorizedHandler(null);
 96 |   }, [logout, navigate]);
 97 | 
 98 |   const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
 99 |     () => ({
100 |       user,
101 |       token,
102 |       isAdmin: user?.role === 'ADMIN',
103 |       login,
104 |       register,
105 |       logout,
106 |     }),
107 |     [user, token, login, register, logout],
108 |   );
109 | 
110 |   return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
111 | }
112 | 
113 | /** Hook to access authentication state; must be used within an AuthProvider. */
114 | // eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components
115 | export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
116 |   const context = useContext(AuthContext);
117 |   if (!context) {
118 |     throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
119 |   }
120 |   return context;
121 | }

 1 | import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
 2 | import { getVehicles, searchVehicles } from '../api/client';
 3 | import type { Vehicle, VehicleFilters } from '../types';
 4 | 
 5 | /** True when at least one filter field has a meaningful value. */
 6 | function hasFilters(filters: VehicleFilters): boolean {
 7 |   return Object.values(filters).some((value) => value !== undefined && value !== '');
 8 | }
 9 | 
10 | /** State and actions for the vehicle inventory list. */
11 | export interface UseVehiclesResult {
12 |   vehicles: Vehicle[];
13 |   loading: boolean;
14 |   error: string | null;
15 |   applyFilters: (filters: VehicleFilters) => Promise<void>;
16 |   refresh: () => Promise<void>;
17 |   replaceVehicle: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
18 | }
19 | 
20 | /**
21 |  * Loads vehicles and exposes filtering, refreshing and local replacement.
22 |  * Uses the search endpoint only when at least one filter is set and ignores
23 |  * stale responses by tracking the latest request id.
24 |  */
25 | export function useVehicles(): UseVehiclesResult {
26 |   const [vehicles, setVehicles] = useState<Vehicle[]>([]);
27 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
28 |   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
29 |   const filtersRef = useRef<VehicleFilters>({});
30 |   const requestIdRef = useRef(0);
31 | 
32 |   const load = useCallback(async () => {
33 |     const requestId = ++requestIdRef.current;
34 |     const filters = filtersRef.current;
35 |     setLoading(true);
36 |     setError(null);
37 | 
38 |     try {
39 |       const data = hasFilters(filters) ? await searchVehicles(filters) : await getVehicles();
40 |       if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
41 |         setVehicles(data);
42 |       }
43 |     } catch (err) {
44 |       if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
45 |         setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
46 |       }
47 |     } finally {
48 |       if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
49 |         setLoading(false);
50 |       }
51 |     }
52 |   }, []);
53 | 
54 |   useEffect(() => {
55 |     void load();
56 |   }, [load]);
57 | 
58 |   const applyFilters = useCallback(
59 |     async (filters: VehicleFilters) => {
60 |       filtersRef.current = filters;
61 |       await load();
62 |     },
63 |     [load],
64 |   );
65 | 
66 |   const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
67 |     await load();
68 |   }, [load]);
69 | 
70 |   const replaceVehicle = useCallback((updated: Vehicle) => {
71 |     setVehicles((current) =>
72 |       current.map((vehicle) => (vehicle.id === updated.id ? updated : vehicle)),
73 |     );
74 |   }, []);
75 | 
76 |   return { vehicles, loading, error, applyFilters, refresh, replaceVehicle };
77 | }

 15 | /** Key under which the auth token is stored in localStorage. */
 16 | export const TOKEN_KEY = 'token';

 18 | /** Base API URL, read from the environment with a sensible local default. */
 19 | const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4000';

 21 | /** Reads the persisted token, tolerating environments without localStorage. */
 22 | function getToken(): string | null {
 23 |   try {
 24 |     return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
 25 |   } catch {
 26 |     return null;
 27 |   }
 28 | }
 29 | 
 30 | /** Parses a response body as JSON, returning undefined for empty (e.g. 204) bodies. */
 31 | async function parseBody(response: Response): Promise<unknown> {
 32 |   if (response.status === 204) {
 33 |     return undefined;
 34 |   }
 35 |   return response.json();
 36 | }
 37 | 
 38 | /**
 39 |  * Thin fetch wrapper around the backend API.
 40 |  * Attaches a bearer token when present and surfaces server error messages.
 41 |  *
 42 |  * @throws {Error} With the server's `error.message` when the response is not 2xx.
 43 |  */
 44 | async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
 45 |   const token = getToken();
 46 |   const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
 47 |   headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
 48 |   if (token) {
 49 |     headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
 50 |   }
 51 | 
 52 |   const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, { ...options, headers });
 53 | 
 54 |   if (!response.ok) {
 55 |     const body = (await parseBody(response)) as { error?: { message?: string } } | undefined;
 56 |     // Only authenticated requests should trigger the global 401 handler.
 57 |     if (response.status === 401 && token) {
 58 |       unauthorizedHandler?.();
 59 |     }
 60 |     throw new Error(body?.error?.message ?? `Request failed with status ${response.status}`);
 61 |   }
 62 | 
 63 |   return (await parseBody(response)) as T;
 64 | }

 66 | /** Callback invoked when an authenticated request receives a 401. */
 67 | type UnauthorizedHandler = () => void;
 68 | 
 69 | let unauthorizedHandler: UnauthorizedHandler | null = null;
 70 | 
 71 | /**

 73 |  * The AuthProvider registers this so expired sessions can clear state and
 74 |  * redirect to /login without the client importing the router.
 75 |  */
 76 | export function setUnauthorizedHandler(handler: UnauthorizedHandler | null): void {
 77 |   unauthorizedHandler = handler;

17 |         Open modal
18 |       </button>

21 |           title="Test dialog"
22 |           onClose={() => {
23 |             setOpen(false);
24 |             onCloseSpy?.();
25 |           }}
26 |         >
27 |           <button type="button">First</button>
28 |           <input aria-label="field" />
29 |           <button type="button">Last</button>
30 |         </Modal>
31 |       )}
32 |     </div>
33 |   );
34 | }

Actually, `getByText` matches against the *text content* of elements, but by default it only matches elements whose *own* text (the text of the node and its children, considering only direct text nodes?) Let me recall Testing Library's `getByText` behavior.

`getByText` uses `matches` on the element's text content. Specifically, the default matcher checks `element.textContent` for the *element itself*, and importantly it also checks that the text is from a single element — it uses `getNodeText(node)` which concatenates the direct text nodes of `node` only (not descendants). Wait, let me recall precisely.

From Testing Library docs: `getByText` will match the element that directly contains the text. The function `getNodeText(node)` returns the concatenation of `node.textContent` but only for text nodes that are direct children? Actually no.

Let me recall: The `*ByText` queries use `getDefaultNormalizer` and the `matches` function checks `getNodeText(node)`. `getNodeText`:
```js
function getNodeText(node) {
  if (node.matches('input[type=submit], input[type=button]')) {
    return node.value;
  }
  return Array.from(node.childNodes)
    .filter(child => child.nodeType === TEXT_NODE)
    .map(child => child.textContent)
    .join('');
}
```

So `getNodeText` only considers *direct* text node children. So if I have:
```html
<h3>
  <span>Toyota</span>
  <span>Model 1</span>
</h3>
```
The h3's direct text nodes are none (children are spans), so `getNodeText(h3)` returns '' → won't match "Toyota Model 1".

If instead:
```html
<h3>
  Toyota
  <span>Model 1</span>
</h3>
```
Then getNodeText(h3) = "Toyota" (plus maybe whitespace), not "Toyota Model 1".

So no single node would have text "Toyota Model 1".

ToastProvider needs to render the viewport. Let me write it.

```tsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, X, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

type ToastType = 'success' | 'error';

interface Toast {
  id: number;
  message: string;
  type: ToastType;
}

interface ToastContextValue {
  toast: (message: string, type?: ToastType) => void;
  success: (message: string) => void;
  error: (message: string) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

const AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 4000;

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id: number) => {
    setToasts((current) => current.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const toast = useCallback((message: string, type: ToastType = 'success') => {
    const id = ++idRef.current;
    setToasts((current) => [...current, { id, message, type }]);
    window.setTimeout(() => dismiss(id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS);
  }, [dismiss]);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    toast,
    success: (message: string) => toast(message, 'success'),
    error: (message: string) => toast(message, 'error'),
  }), [toast]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      <div aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false" className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-4 top-4 z-[60] flex flex-col items-end gap-2 sm:inset-x-auto sm:bottom-4 sm:right-4 sm:top-auto">
        {toasts.map((t) => (
          <div key={t.id} className="pointer-events-auto ...">
            ...
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast() { ... }
```

```tsx
export default function Navbar() {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-line bg-ink/80 backdrop-blur-md">
      <nav className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6">
        <Link to="/" className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span className="logo mark"><Car icon /></span>
          <span className="font-display text-lg font-semibold text-slate-50">Car Dealership</span>
        </Link>

        {/* Desktop */}
        <div className="hidden items-center gap-4 md:flex">
          {user ? (
            <>
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-300">{user.email}</span>
              <RoleBadge role={user.role} />
              <button onClick={logout} className={...}>Logout</button>  // with LogOut icon
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Link to="/login">Login</Link>
              <Link to="/register">Register</Link>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Mobile hamburger */}
        <button className="md:hidden" aria-label="Open menu" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(v=>!v)}>
          <Menu />
        </button>
      </nav>

      {/* Mobile menu */}
      {menuOpen && (
        <div className="md:hidden border-t border-line px-4 py-3">
          {user ? (
            <div>
              <span>{user.email}</span>
              <RoleBadge/>
              <button onClick={()=>{logout(); setMenuOpen(false);}}>Logout</button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div>
              <Link to="/login" onClick={close}>Login</Link>
              <Link to="/register" onClick={close}>Register</Link>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}
```

Content: @tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

@layer base {
  :root {
    color-scheme: dark;
  }

  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }

  body {
    @apply bg-canvas font-sans text-slate-200 antialiased;
  }

  /* Consistent, always-visible keyboard focus. */
  :focus-visible {
    @apply outline-none ring-2 ring-accent-400 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-canvas;
  }

  ::selection {
    @apply bg-accent-500/40 text-white;
  }

  /* Tabular numbers for prices and any numeric data. */
  .tabular-nums {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
}

@layer utilities {
  .text-gradient-accent {
    @apply bg-gradient-to-r from-accent-300 via-accent-400 to-accent-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent;
  }

  .bg-gradient-accent {
    @apply bg-gradient-to-r from-accent-500 to-accent-700;
  }

  .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
  .no-scrollbar {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }

  .animate-card {
    animation: fade-in 250ms ease-out both;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
  }
}

[Tool Use: write_to_file]
Path: frontend/src/context/ToastContext.tsx
Content: import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { CheckCircle2, X, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';

type ToastTone = 'success' | 'error';

interface Toast {
  id: number;
  message: string;
  tone: ToastTone;
}

interface ToastContextValue {
  toast: (message: string, tone?: ToastTone) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

const AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 4000;

/**
 * Provides a lightweight toast system. Toasts stack in the bottom-right on
 * desktop and across the top on mobile, auto-dismiss and can be dismissed.
 */
export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id: number) => {
    setToasts((current) => current.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const toast = useCallback(
    (message: string, tone: ToastTone = 'success') => {
      const id = ++idRef.current;
      setToasts((current) => [...current, { id, message, tone }]);
      window.setTimeout(() => dismiss(id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS);
    },
    [dismiss],
  );

  const value = useMemo<ToastContextValue>(() => ({ toast }), [toast]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      {createPortal(
        <div
          aria-live="polite"
          aria-label="Notifications"
          className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2 px-4 pt-4 sm:inset-x-auto sm:bottom-4 sm:right-4 sm:top-auto sm:items-end sm:px-0 sm:pt-0"
        >
          {toasts.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              role="status"
              className="pointer-events-auto flex w-full max-w-sm items-start gap-3 rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface-raised px-4 py-3 shadow-modal animate-toast-in"
            >
              {item.tone === 'success' ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-ok" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : (
                <XCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-danger" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              <p className="flex-1 text-sm text-slate-100">{item.message}</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => dismiss(item.id)}
                aria-label="Dismiss notification"
                className="rounded-md p-1 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-200 hover:text-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>,
        document.body,
      )}
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

/** Hook to show toasts; must be used within a ToastProvider. */
// eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components
export function useToast(): ToastContextValue {
  const context = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useToast must be used within a ToastProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

Content: import { Car } from 'lucide-react';

interface LogoProps {
  compact?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Brand mark plus wordmark. The mark is a rounded gradient tile with a car
 * icon; the wordmark uses the display font.
 */
export default function Logo({ compact = false }: LogoProps) {
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <span
        className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-accent text-canvas shadow-glow"
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <Car className="h-5 w-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />
      </span>
      {!compact && (
        <span className="font-display text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-white">
          Showroom
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Left-hand brand panel for the auth split layout. Hidden on small screens,
 * it presents a headline, value proposition and a decorative gradient with a
 * car silhouette.
 */
export default function BrandPanel() {
  return (
    <section
      className="relative hidden overflow-hidden border-r border-line bg-canvas-50 lg:flex lg:flex-col lg:justify-between lg:p-12"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -left-24 top-1/3 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-accent-500/20 blur-3xl" />
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 bottom-0 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-accent-700/20 blur-3xl" />

      <div className="relative">
        <Logo />
      </div>

      <div className="relative max-w-md">
        <h2 className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold leading-tight text-white">
          Your inventory, under the lights.
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-300">
          Browse, filter and manage every vehicle in one polished showroom — real-time stock,
          clear pricing and controls that stay out of the way.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-10">
        <div className="rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-gradient-to-br from-surface to-canvas p-8 shadow-card">
          <CarSilhouette />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Inline-SVG sports car silhouette with an amber gradient. */

  return (

          <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#fbbf24" />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#ea580c" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <g fill="url(#brand-car-grad)">
        <path d="M28 82c0-4 2-7 5-9l14-8 22-10 20-6 18-3 16 2 15 6 13 9 12 12 6 9a9 9 0 0 1 1 3v8a10 10 0 0 1-10 10H37a10 10 0 0 1-9-7l-4-10a8 8 0 0 1 0-3z" />
        <path
          d="M46 88h228a6 6 0 0 1 6 6v2a6 6 0 0 1-6 6H46a6 6 0 0 1-6-6v-2a6 6 0 0 1 6-6z"
          opacity="0.55"

      <g fill="#0B1020">

Content: import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { LogOut, Menu, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import Logo from './Logo';

/**
 * Top navigation bar: sticky with a translucent blur. Shows the brand mark and
 * wordmark plus either the logged-in user's email, role badge and logout, or
 * login/register links. A toggle reveals the same actions in a mobile menu.
 */
export default function Navbar() {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-line/70 bg-canvas/80 backdrop-blur-md">
      <nav className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3 sm:px-6">
        <Link to="/" aria-label="Showroom home" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
          <Logo />
        </Link>

        {/* Desktop actions */}
        <div className="hidden items-center gap-4 md:flex">
          {user ? (
            <LoggedInActions user={user} onLogout={logout} />
          ) : (
            <LoggedOutActions />
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Mobile menu toggle */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls="mobile-nav"
          aria-label="Toggle menu"
          className="rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface p-2 text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:text-white md:hidden"
        >
          {open ? <X className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Menu className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />}
        </button>
      </nav>

      {/* Mobile menu */}
      {open && (
        <div
          id="mobile-nav"
          className="border-t border-line bg-surface px-4 py-4 md:hidden"
        >
          {user ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <LoggedInActions user={user} onLogout={logout} column />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <LoggedOutActions column />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

interface LoggedInActionsProps {
  user: { email: string; role: 'USER' | 'ADMIN' };
  onLogout: () => void;
  column?: boolean;
}

function LoggedInActions({ user, onLogout, column = false }: LoggedInActionsProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${column ? 'flex-col' : 'flex-row'} flex items-${column ? 'stretch' : 'center'} gap-4`}>
      <div className={`flex ${column ? 'flex-col' : 'flex-row'} items-${column ? 'stretch' : 'center'} gap-3`}>
        <span className="text-sm text-slate-300">{user.email}</span>
        <span
          className={`rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${
            user.role === 'ADMIN'
              ? 'border-accent-500/30 bg-accent-500/15 text-accent-300'
              : 'border-line bg-surface-200 text-slate-300'
          }`}
        >
          {user.role === 'ADMIN' ? 'Admin' : 'User'}
        </span>
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onLogout}
        className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface-raised px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:border-danger/50 hover:text-danger"
      >
        <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        Logout
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function LoggedOutActions({ column = false }: { column?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className={`flex ${column ? 'flex-col' : 'flex-row'} items-${column ? 'stretch' : 'center'} gap-3`}>
      <Link
        to="/login"
        className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:text-white"
      >
        Login
      </Link>
      <Link
        to="/register"
        className="rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white shadow-glow transition-transform hover:scale-[1.02]"
      >
        Register
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx
Content: import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Eye, EyeOff, Lock, Mail } from 'lucide-react';
import BrandPanel from '../components/BrandPanel';
import Spinner from '../components/Spinner';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { validateEmail, validatePassword } from '../utils/validation';

/**
 * Login page. Split layout with a brand panel on large screens and a form on
 * the right. Client-side validation, password visibility toggle, loading
 * state and server error rendering. Authenticated users redirect to the
 * dashboard, and a successful login replaces /login in history.
 */
export default function LoginPage() {
  const { login, token } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ email?: string; password?: string }>({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  if (token) {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    const emailError = validateEmail(email);
    const passwordError = validatePassword(password);
    setFieldErrors({ email: emailError ?? undefined, password: passwordError ?? undefined });

    if (emailError || passwordError) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim(), password);
      navigate('/', { replace: true });
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid min-h-screen lg:grid-cols-2">
      <BrandPanel />

      <div className="flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-12 sm:px-8">
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-white">Log in</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-400">Welcome back to the dealership inventory.</p>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-8 space-y-5" noValidate>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Email
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Mail
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2.5 pl-10 pr-3 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500"
                />
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.email && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.email}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Password
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Lock
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2.5 pl-10 pr-11 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword((current) => !current)}
                  aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                  className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1.5 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:text-slate-200"
                >
                  {showPassword ? (
                    <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.password && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.password}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {serverError && (
              <p className="rounded-lg border border-danger/40 bg-danger-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-danger">
                {serverError}
              </p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {loading && <Spinner />}
              {loading ? 'Logging in…' : 'Log in'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-slate-400">
            Don't have an account?{' '}
            <Link to="/register" className="font-medium text-accent-400 hover:text-accent-300">
              Register
            </Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx
Content: import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Eye, EyeOff, Lock, Mail } from 'lucide-react';
import BrandPanel from '../components/BrandPanel';
import Spinner from '../components/Spinner';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { validateEmail, validatePassword } from '../utils/validation';

/**
 * Registration page. Split layout with a brand panel on large screens and the
 * form on the right. Validates email, password length and confirmation, then
 * creates the account and redirects to /login (registering does not log in).
 * Authenticated users are redirected straight to the dashboard.
 */
export default function RegisterPage() {
  const { register, token } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{
    email?: string;
    password?: string;
    confirmPassword?: string;
  }>({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  if (token) {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    const emailError = validateEmail(email);
    const passwordError = validatePassword(password);
    const confirmPasswordError =
      password !== confirmPassword ? 'Passwords do not match' : undefined;

    setFieldErrors({
      email: emailError ?? undefined,
      password: passwordError ?? undefined,
      confirmPassword: confirmPasswordError,
    });

    if (emailError || passwordError || confirmPasswordError) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await register(email.trim(), password);
      navigate('/login');
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const inputClass =
    'w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2.5 pl-10 pr-11 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500';

  return (
    <div className="grid min-h-screen lg:grid-cols-2">
      <BrandPanel />

      <div className="flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-12 sm:px-8">
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-white">Create an account</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-400">Register to manage the dealership inventory.</p>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-8 space-y-5" noValidate>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Email
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Mail
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2.5 pl-10 pr-3 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500"
                />
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.email && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.email}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Password
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Lock
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  className={inputClass}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword((current) => !current)}
                  aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                  className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1.5 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:text-slate-200"
                >
                  {showPassword ? (
                    <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.password && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.password}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="confirmPassword" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Confirm password
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Lock
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="confirmPassword"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  value={confirmPassword}
                  onChange={(event) => setConfirmPassword(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  className={inputClass}
                />
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.confirmPassword && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.confirmPassword}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {serverError && (
              <p className="rounded-lg border border-danger/40 bg-danger-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-danger">
                {serverError}
              </p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {loading && <Spinner />}
              {loading ? 'Registering…' : 'Register'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-slate-400">
            Already have an account?{' '}
            <Link to="/login" className="font-medium text-accent-400 hover:text-accent-300">
              Log in
            </Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Content: import { Navigate, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import Navbar from './components/Navbar';
import ProtectedRoute from './components/ProtectedRoute';
import { ToastProvider } from './context/ToastContext';
import DashboardPage from './pages/DashboardPage';
import LoginPage from './pages/LoginPage';
import RegisterPage from './pages/RegisterPage';

/** Top-level application routes. */
export default function App() {
  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-canvas">
        <Navbar />
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
          <Route path="/register" element={<RegisterPage />} />
          <Route
            path="/"
            element={
              <ProtectedRoute>
                <DashboardPage />
              </ProtectedRoute>
            }
          />
          <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
        </Routes>
      </div>
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}

Content: import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Search, SlidersHorizontal, X } from 'lucide-react';
import type { VehicleFilters as FilterValues } from '../types';

interface VehicleFiltersProps {
  categories: string[];
  onApply: (filters: FilterValues) => void;
}

const EMPTY_FILTERS: FilterValues = {};

/** Reads a numeric price input, returning undefined for blank or NaN values. */
function toNumber(value: string): number | undefined {
  if (value === '') return undefined;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? undefined : parsed;
}

/**
 * Inventory filter controls rendered as a sticky bar. Category chips (All plus
 * each category) apply immediately; text inputs are debounced by 300ms; price
 * inputs apply immediately but block (with an inline message) when min > max.
 */
export default function VehicleFilters({ categories, onApply }: VehicleFiltersProps) {
  const [make, setMake] = useState('');
  const [model, setModel] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('');
  const [minPrice, setMinPrice] = useState('');
  const [maxPrice, setMaxPrice] = useState('');
  const [priceError, setPriceError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  function applyFilters(next: FilterValues) {
    onApply(next);
  }

  function clear() {
    setMake('');
    setModel('');
    setCategory('');
    setMinPrice('');
    setMaxPrice('');
    setPriceError(null);
    applyFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  }

  function applyPriceFilters(nextMin: string, nextMax: string) {
    const min = toNumber(nextMin);
    const max = toNumber(nextMax);
    if (min !== undefined && max !== undefined && min > max) {
      setPriceError('Min price must not be greater than max price');
      return;
    }
    setPriceError(null);
    applyFilters({
      make: make || undefined,
      model: model || undefined,
      category: category || undefined,
      minPrice: min,
      maxPrice: max,
    });
  }

  // Debounce text inputs so a request is only fired after typing stops.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      applyFilters({
        make: make || undefined,
        model: model || undefined,
        category: category || undefined,
        minPrice: toNumber(minPrice),
        maxPrice: toNumber(maxPrice),
      });
    }, 300);

    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [make, model, category]);

  const inputClass =
    'w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500';

  return (
    <div className="sticky top-16 z-30 rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface/90 shadow-card backdrop-blur-md">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
        <SlidersHorizontal className="h-4 w-4 text-accent-400" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-200">Filters</span>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-4 p-4">
        {/* Category chips */}
        <fieldset>
          <legend className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">Category</legend>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <CategoryChip active={category === ''} onClick={() => setCategory('')} label="All" />
            {categories.map((option) => (
              <CategoryChip
                key={option}
                active={category === option}
                onClick={() => setCategory(option)}
                label={option}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="make" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Make
            </label>
            <div className="relative mt-1.5">
              <Search
                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <input
                id="make"
                type="text"
                value={make}
                onChange={(event) => setMake(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Toyota"
                className={inputClass}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="model" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Model
            </label>
            <div className="relative mt-1.5">
              <Search
                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <input
                id="model"
                type="text"
                value={model}
                onChange={(event) => setModel(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Corolla"
                className={inputClass}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="minPrice" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Min price
            </label>
            <input
              id="minPrice"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={minPrice}
              onChange={(event) => {
                const next = event.target.value;
                setMinPrice(next);
                applyPriceFilters(next, maxPrice);
              }}
              placeholder="0"
              className={`mt-1.5 ${inputClass}`}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="maxPrice" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Max price
            </label>
            <input
              id="maxPrice"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={maxPrice}
              onChange={(event) => {
                const next = event.target.value;
                setMaxPrice(next);
                applyPriceFilters(minPrice, next);
              }}
              placeholder="Any"
              className={`mt-1.5 ${inputClass}`}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
          {priceError && (
            <p className="text-sm text-danger" role="alert">
              {priceError}
            </p>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={clear}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface-raised px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:border-danger/50 hover:text-danger"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            Clear
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface CategoryChipProps {
  label: string;
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
}

function CategoryChip({ label, active, onClick }: CategoryChipProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-pressed={active}
      className={`rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
        active
          ? 'border-accent-500 bg-accent-500/15 text-accent-300'
          : 'border-line bg-surface-raised text-slate-300 hover:border-accent-500/50 hover:text-slate-100'
      }`}
    >
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}

Content: interface VehicleIllustrationProps {
  category: string;
  /** Make initials shown subtly behind the illustration. */
  initials: string;
}

/**
 * Inline-SVG vehicle illustration chosen by category. A generic car is used
 * for unknown categories, and the make initials are rendered behind the
 * silhouette as a subtle watermark.
 */
export default function VehicleIllustration({ category, initials }: VehicleIllustrationProps) {
  const normalized = category.trim().toLowerCase();
  const Body = pickBody(normalized);

  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 240 120"
      className="h-full w-full"
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${category} illustration`}
    >
      <text
        x="120"
        y="72"
        textAnchor="middle"
        className="fill-white/15 font-display"
        fontSize="44"
        fontWeight="700"
      >
        {initials}
      </text>
      <g transform="translate(20 24)">
        <Body />
      </g>
    </svg>
  );
}

type BodyProps = Record<string, never>;

function pickBody(category: string): (props: BodyProps) => React.ReactElement {
  if (category.includes('suv')) return SuvBody;
  if (category.includes('hatch')) return HatchbackBody;
  if (category.includes('truck')) return TruckBody;
  if (category.includes('coupe')) return CoupeBody;
  if (category.includes('electric') || category.includes('ev')) return ElectricBody;
  if (category.includes('sedan')) return SedanBody;
  return GenericBody;
}

/** Shared gradient for the silhouette fill. */
function Gradient() {
  return (
    <linearGradient id="vehicle-body" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0.95" />
      <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0.55" />
    </linearGradient>
  );
}

function Wheels() {
  return (
    <g fill="#0B1020" opacity="0.9">
      <circle cx="54" cy="76" r="15" />
      <circle cx="146" cy="76" r="15" />
    </g>
  );
}

function SedanBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M20 78c0-4 2-7 5-9l18-8 16-6 18-3 26 1 20 5 16 8 10 9 4 6a9 9 0 0 1 0 7l-1 3a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H28a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-11z"
        fill="url(#vehicle-body)"
      />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function SuvBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M16 80c0-3 1-6 3-8l14-9 20-7 22-3 20 1 18 5 16 9 10 10 3 6a8 8 0 0 1 0 6l-2 5a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H24a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-13z"
        fill="url(#vehicle-body)"
      />
      <rect x="70" y="26" width="60" height="30" rx="4" fill="#0B1020" opacity="0.45" />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function HatchbackBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M18 80c0-4 1-7 4-9l16-8 20-5 20-1 22 2 18 6 15 9 7 8 1 4a9 9 0 0 1-1 6l-2 4a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H26a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-14z"
        fill="url(#vehicle-body)"
      />
      <path d="M110 62l24 14" stroke="#0B1020" strokeOpacity="0.4" strokeWidth="3" />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function TruckBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path d="M14 80c0-3 1-6 3-8l14-8 20-6 22-2 20 2 16 6 14 9 6 8v10a8 8 0 0 1-8 8H22a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-11z" fill="url(#vehicle-body)" />
      <rect x="126" y="30" width="52" height="38" rx="3" fill="url(#vehicle-body)" opacity="0.8" />
      <Wheels />
    </g>

Path: frontend/src/components/VehicleCard.tsx
Content: import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { purchaseVehicle } from '../api/client';
import Spinner from './Spinner';
import VehicleIllustration from './VehicleIllustration';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';

interface VehicleCardProps {
  vehicle: Vehicle;
  onPurchased: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
  onError: () => void;
  onEdit?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDelete?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onRestock?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
}

const priceFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
  style: 'currency',
  currency: 'USD',
});

/** Deterministic, category-tinted gradient for the card header. */
function gradientFor(category: string): string {
  const tints: Record<string, string> = {
    sedan: 'from-sky-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    suv: 'from-violet-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    hatchback: 'from-emerald-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    truck: 'from-amber-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    coupe: 'from-rose-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    electric: 'from-cyan-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
  };
  return tints[category.trim().toLowerCase()] ?? 'from-accent-500/25 via-canvas to-canvas';
}

/** Upcased initials of the make (first letters of each word). */
function initialsOf(make: string): string {
  return make
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((word) => word.charAt(0))
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase();
}

/** Stock metadata: text label, tone and a progress ratio out of 10. */
function stockInfo(quantity: number): { label: string; tone: 'ok' | 'warn' | 'danger' } {
  if (quantity === 0) return { label: 'Out of stock', tone: 'danger' };
  if (quantity <= 3) return { label: `Only ${quantity} left`, tone: 'warn' };
  return { label: `${quantity} in stock`, tone: 'ok' };
}

const TONE_TEXT: Record<string, string> = {
  ok: 'text-ok',
  warn: 'text-warn',
  danger: 'text-danger',
};

const TONE_BAR: Record<string, string> = {
  ok: 'bg-ok',
  warn: 'bg-warn',
  danger: 'bg-danger',
};

/**
 * Presents a single vehicle with a category illustration header, big price,
 * stock indicator with progress bar, purchase action and inline errors. Admins
 * additionally get a compact icon row for Edit, Restock and Delete.
 */
export default function VehicleCard({
  vehicle,
  onPurchased,
  onError,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onRestock,
}: VehicleCardProps) {
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(vehicle);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Reflect parent-side updates (e.g. restock/edit replacing the vehicle).
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrent(vehicle);
  }, [vehicle]);

  async function handlePurchase() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const updated = await purchaseVehicle(current.id);
      setCurrent(updated);
      onPurchased(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
      onError();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const outOfStock = current.quantity === 0;
  const stock = stockInfo(current.quantity);
  const stockRatio = Math.min(current.quantity / 10, 1);

  return (
    <article className="group flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface shadow-card transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-accent-500/40 hover:shadow-card-hover">
      <div
        className={`relative flex h-36 items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br ${gradientFor(current.category)}`}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex items-center justify-between px-4 pt-3">
          <span className="rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-white backdrop-blur-sm">
            {current.category}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-full w-4/5">
          <VehicleIllustration category={current.category} initials={initialsOf(current.make)} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-5">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-accent-400">
          {current.make}
        </p>
        <h3 className="mt-1 font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">{current.model}</h3>

        <p className="tabular-nums mt-2 font-display text-2xl font-bold text-white">
          {priceFormatter.format(current.price)}
        </p>

        {/* Stock indicator: text plus progress bar so colour is not the only cue. */}
        <div className="mt-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${TONE_TEXT[stock.tone]}`}>{stock.label}</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              {stockRatio >= 1 ? 'Full' : `${Math.round(stockRatio * 100)}%`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-line">
            <div
              className={`h-full rounded-full ${TONE_BAR[stock.tone]} transition-all duration-300`}
              style={{ width: `${Math.max(stockRatio * 100, 4)}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {isAdmin && (
          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <AdminIconButton
              label={`Edit ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              onClick={() => onEdit?.(current)}
              tone="default"
            >
              <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </AdminIconButton>
            <AdminIconButton
              label={`Restock ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              onClick={() => onRestock?.(current)}
              tone="default"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </AdminIconButton>
            <AdminIconButton
              label={`Delete ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              onClick={() => onDelete?.(current)}
              tone="danger"
            >
              <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </AdminIconButton>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 flex-1" />

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handlePurchase}
          disabled={outOfStock || loading}
          aria-label={`Purchase ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
          className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-none disabled:bg-surface-200 disabled:text-slate-500 disabled:shadow-none"
        >
          {loading && <Spinner />}
          {loading ? 'Purchasing…' : outOfStock ? 'Sold out' : 'Purchase'}
        </button>

        <div aria-live="polite" className="mt-3 min-h-[1.25rem]">
          {error && <p className="text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

interface AdminIconButtonProps {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  tone: 'default' | 'danger';
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function AdminIconButton({ label, onClick, tone, children }: AdminIconButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      className={`rounded-lg border p-2 transition-colors ${
        tone === 'danger'
          ? 'border-line text-slate-400 hover:border-danger/50 hover:text-danger'
          : 'border-line text-slate-400 hover:border-accent-500/50 hover:text-accent-400'
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/VehicleGrid.tsx
Content: import { AlertTriangle, Car, SearchX } from 'lucide-react';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import VehicleCard from './VehicleCard';

interface VehicleGridProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  onClearFilters: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onPurchased: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
  onError: () => void;
  onEdit?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDelete?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onRestock?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
}

/**
 * Responsive grid of vehicle cards with shimmer skeleton loading, an
 * illustrated empty state and an error state with retry.
 */
export default function VehicleGrid({
  vehicles,
  loading,
  error,
  onClearFilters,
  onRetry,
  onPurchased,
  onError,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onRestock,
}: VehicleGridProps) {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, index) => (
          <SkeletonCard key={index} />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface p-10 text-center shadow-card">
        <span className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-danger-muted">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6 text-danger" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <h3 className="mt-4 font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">
          We couldn't load the showroom
        </h3>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-slate-400">{error}</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="mt-5 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110"
        >
          Retry
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (vehicles.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface p-10 text-center shadow-card">
        <span className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface-200">
          <SearchX className="h-6 w-6 text-slate-400" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <h3 className="mt-4 font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">
          No vehicles match your filters
        </h3>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-slate-400">
          Try adjusting the filters to see more of the inventory.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClearFilters}
          className="mt-5 rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface-raised px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:border-accent-500/50 hover:text-white"
        >
          Clear filters
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
      {vehicles.map((vehicle, index) => (
        <div
          key={vehicle.id}
          className="animate-card"
          style={{ animationDelay: `${Math.min(index * 40, 400)}ms` }}
        >
          <VehicleCard
            vehicle={vehicle}
            onPurchased={onPurchased}
            onError={onError}
            onEdit={onEdit}
            onDelete={onDelete}
            onRestock={onRestock}
          />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Shimmer placeholder matching the vehicle card layout. */
function SkeletonCard() {
  return (
    <div
      className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface shadow-card"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div className="h-36 animate-pulse bg-surface-200" />
      <div className="space-y-3 p-5">
        <div className="h-3 w-1/3 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-200" />
        <div className="h-5 w-2/3 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-200" />
        <div className="h-7 w-1/2 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-200" />
        <div className="h-1.5 w-full animate-pulse rounded-full bg-surface-200" />
        <div className="h-10 w-full animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-surface-200" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Content: import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Car, Layers, Plus, PackageCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  createVehicle,
  deleteVehicle,
  restockVehicle,
  updateVehicle,
  type CreateVehicleInput,
  type UpdateVehicleInput,
} from '../api/client';
import ConfirmDeleteModal from '../components/ConfirmDeleteModal';
import RestockModal from '../components/RestockModal';
import VehicleFilters from '../components/VehicleFilters';
import VehicleFormModal from '../components/VehicleFormModal';
import VehicleGrid from '../components/VehicleGrid';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../context/ToastContext';
import { useVehicles } from '../hooks/useVehicles';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';

type ModalState =
  | { type: 'add' }
  | { type: 'edit'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | { type: 'delete'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | { type: 'restock'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | null;

/**
 * Inventory dashboard: hero banner with stats strip, sticky filters and the
 * vehicle grid. Admins can add, edit, restock and delete through modals.
 * Success feedback is delivered through toasts.
 */
export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { vehicles, loading, error, applyFilters, refresh, replaceVehicle } = useVehicles();
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<ModalState>(null);

  const categories = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set(vehicles.map((vehicle) => vehicle.category))).sort(),
    [vehicles],
  );

  const inStock = useMemo(
    () => vehicles.filter((vehicle) => vehicle.quantity > 0).length,
    [vehicles],
  );

  function clearFilters() {
    void applyFilters({});
  }

  async function handleAdd(data: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput) {
    await createVehicle(data as CreateVehicleInput);
    setModal(null);
    toast(`${data.make} ${data.model} added`);
    await refresh();
  }

  async function handleEdit(vehicle: Vehicle, data: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput) {
    const updated = await updateVehicle(vehicle.id, data as UpdateVehicleInput);
    replaceVehicle(updated);
    setModal(null);
    toast(`${updated.make} ${updated.model} updated`);
  }

  async function handleDelete(vehicle: Vehicle) {
    await deleteVehicle(vehicle.id);
    setModal(null);
    toast(`${vehicle.make} ${vehicle.model} deleted`);
    await refresh();
  }

  async function handleRestock(vehicle: Vehicle, quantity: number) {
    const updated = await restockVehicle(vehicle.id, quantity);
    replaceVehicle(updated);
    setModal(null);
    toast(`${updated.make} ${updated.model} restocked`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6">
      {/* Hero banner */}
      <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-gradient-to-br from-surface-raised via-surface to-canvas p-6 shadow-card sm:p-8">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-10 -top-10 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-accent-500/20 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="relative flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-white sm:text-3xl">
              The showroom floor
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-2 max-w-lg text-sm text-slate-400">
              Every vehicle in inventory, ready to browse, filter and manage.
            </p>
          </div>
          {isAdmin && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setModal({ type: 'add' })}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              Add vehicle
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Stats strip */}
        <dl className="relative mt-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Stat icon={<Car className="h-5 w-5 text-accent-400" aria-hidden="true" />} label="Total vehicles" value={String(vehicles.length)} />
          <Stat icon={<PackageCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-ok" aria-hidden="true" />} label="In stock" value={String(inStock)} />
          <Stat icon={<Layers className="h-5 w-5 text-warn" aria-hidden="true" />} label="Categories" value={String(categories.length)} />
        </dl>
      </section>

      <div className="mt-6">
        <VehicleFilters categories={categories} onApply={(filters) => void applyFilters(filters)} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8">
        <VehicleGrid
          vehicles={vehicles}
          loading={loading}
          error={error}
          onClearFilters={clearFilters}
          onRetry={() => void refresh()}
          onPurchased={replaceVehicle}
          onError={() => void refresh()}
          onEdit={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'edit', vehicle }) : undefined}
          onDelete={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'delete', vehicle }) : undefined}
          onRestock={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'restock', vehicle }) : undefined}
        />
      </div>

      {modal?.type === 'add' && (
        <VehicleFormModal
          mode="add"
          initialVehicle={null}
          categories={categories}
          onSubmit={handleAdd}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'edit' && (
        <VehicleFormModal
          mode="edit"
          initialVehicle={modal.vehicle}
          categories={categories}
          onSubmit={(data) => handleEdit(modal.vehicle, data)}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'delete' && (
        <ConfirmDeleteModal
          vehicleName={`${modal.vehicle.make} ${modal.vehicle.model}`}
          onConfirm={() => handleDelete(modal.vehicle)}
          onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'restock' && (
        <RestockModal
          vehicleName={`${modal.vehicle.make} ${modal.vehicle.model}`}
          currentStock={modal.vehicle.quantity}
          onSubmit={(quantity) => handleRestock(modal.vehicle, quantity)}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

interface StatProps {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: string;
}

function Stat({ icon, label, value }: StatProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-surface/70 px-4 py-3">
      <span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-surface-200">
        {icon}
      </span>
      <div>
        <dd className="tabular-nums font-display text-xl font-bold text-white">{value}</dd>
        <dt className="text-xs text-slate-400">{label}</dt>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
